vision: Deliver a verifiable commit investigation system where every quality claim is backed by deterministic infrastructure — not LLM policy. The iter-2 win (D1=0.75, D3=0.292 on n=12 panel) confirms the method works; the iter-3 redesign makes it trustworthy at scale. Script controls risk policy and quality gates; LLM generates hypotheses; Pydantic enforces schema; adversarial eval with a separate judge measures output honesty.
direction: iter-3 is the main track. Sequence: (1) extract archetype + risk_policy + quality_gate stub; (2) evidence_tagger feasibility spike; (3) wire deterministic gates; (4) fix context bundle [parallel: smart-diff]; (5) decompose monolith into HypothesisEngine; (6) THEN fix eval scoring infra (FIX-JUDGE-INFRA ∥ EXP-JUDGE-SWAP); (7) validate + n=20. Judge scoring infra is not a blocker for any refactor step — only needed before iter-3-validate D3/D5.
v2_vision: Close the gap between V1 delivery gates (all 6 pass at n=50) and V2 quality targets — especially D3 root-cause identification (0.23→≥0.35) and D1 calibration (0.70→≥0.80, FP≤25%). Preserve iter-3's Script-first architecture: deterministic risk, evidence tagging, and quality gates remain frozen; V2 improves hypothesis quality, context assembly, localization precision, and selectively re-evaluates multi-turn only where forensics justify it.
v2_direction: V2 sequence: (1) formalize n=50 failure taxonomy; (2) parallel tracks on the three measured gaps — D3 wrong-mechanism (contrastive hypothesis + bundle expand), D1 false positives (risk_policy tightening + evidence strictness), D2 localization (SUPPORTED-only claims); (3) re-spike multi-turn on iter-3 pipeline with turn2_context (prior iter-3f ΔD3=0 is stale); (4) conditional escalation (stronger model) only if Script+prompt fixes exhaust; (5) n=20 iteration gate then n=50 delivery re-run. No rubric-in-prompt regression. max_turns stays 1 until v2-multiturn-spike passes the frozen 3-AND reactivation threshold.
